preconditions.description: swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true. This is set by the owner via activateContract().
The contract's token balance must be greater than or equal to minTokenNumberToSell (1e19) to trigger the swapAndLiquify function.

exploit_hint: The exploit involves triggering the vulnerable `swapAndLiquify` function to create an arbitrage opportunity. First, ensure the contract's token balance meets the `minTokenNumberToSell` threshold by making a transfer of the token to any address; the liquidity fee will accumulate tokens in the contract. Then, make another transfer to trigger the `swapAndLiquify` function. This will add liquidity to the PancakeSwap pair at a disadvantageous price. Immediately execute a swap on PancakeSwap, trading BNB for the now undervalued contract token to exploit the price difference. Finally, swap the obtained tokens back to BNB to realize the profit.
